findings.title: Unsupported source claims still drop all open-mode claims including unrelated supported/general claims
findings.reason: The cited function clears all claims only when mode===strict. Open filters each source claim by its own verdict and keeps non-source claims. The finding body contradicts the actual branch and its own premise.

findings.title: Quote presence alone is treated as exact quotation correctness without checking whether the quote is complete or unambiguous
findings.reason: ExactQuote verification establishes one contiguous byte-equal range, not sentence meaning. The chosen occurrence has deterministic coordinates; the separate support judge validates semantic relevance. No whole-sentence or unique-text requirement exists in Citation/v2.

findings.title: Source citation navigation does not request the raw citation range
findings.reason: The owner reader prioritizes pin.locator, decodes exactly startByte:endByteExclusive, and validates line coordinates. lineCount is used only without a pin. The Electron raw-range screenshot and receipt show only the quote at raw line10, with original headers excluded.

findings.title: Open-mode source claims with no admitted sources are sent to the model without owner/DCS references
findings.reason: runKnowledgeModel always sends modelRun=true, promptMode=none, disableMessageTool=true and internal session effects. Its optional knowledge argument carries pins/workspace selectors, not tool authority. Open empty-source claims can only be general/inference with no citations; source claims fail validation.
